title: PowerPoint on Windows: Copilot agent notifies you when work finishes or needs attention
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the supplied roadmap record, and the documented background controls and licence requirements are supported. Searches on 28 November 2026 found no documentation establishing the notification capability's default, controls, delivery mechanism or specific licensing; the briefing appropriately keeps those questions open.
